title.es: El de cuando estafaron a Clara
title.en: The One Where Clara Was Scammed

description.es: Pelayo y Marta le dicen a Clara que puede que la hayan estafado, pero Clara no se lo cree. Mientras Marta y Fina hablan sobre la estafa a Clara, Clara va a la tienda. Dice que ha llamado al hijo de su conocida, que la construcción sigue en marcha y que no hay ningún problema. Marta propone llevar a Clara al terreno. Fina, Marta y Clara van al terreno. Clara comprende que la han estafado y le da las gracias a Marta efusivamente, dedicándole palabras llenas de elogios.
description.en: Pelayo and Marta tell Clara that she may have been scammed, but Clara does not believe it. As Marta and Fina are talking about Clara being scammed, Clara comes to the store. She says that she called her acquaintance's son, that the construction is under way, and that there is no problem. Marta offers to take Clara to the plot of land. Fina, Marta, and Clara go to the plot. Clara realizes that she has been scammed and thanks Marta profusely, showering her with praise.
